name: Los Arcos to Logroño
notes: from is Los Arcos (relation/341045, same point as stage 6 end). Sansol and Torres del Río are only 0.6 km apart; both are listed to keep the walking order. The Navarra to La Rioja border lies between Viana and Logroño, so both extracts are listed. pais-vasco is not listed: a Nominatim reverse lookup 3 km north of Viana (42.5425,-2.3713) is still Navarra. Logroño: used relation/340516 (linked place=city); a second place=city relation/18754428 without a name link lies 1.2 km away and was not used. Few villages between Viana and Logroño (from memory): reviewer should check that the corridor holds the OSM Camino across the Navarra/La Rioja border.
